summary: Wave UX — Bienvenida Dinámica. Backend + Frontend fully verified on preview URL. Backend: 3/3 pytest pass (test_wave_ux_community_stats.py) — GET /api/community/stats returns {total_members:151>=1, total_companies:39>=1, total_posts:22>=0, generated_at:iso} without auth; POST /api/community/auth/register with fresh email increments total_members by 1 (151→152); regression /api/discovery/trending?limit=5 and /api/discovery/entity/microsoft/related still return required keys. Frontend: (1) Anon / → workspace-members-counter shows '151' (Intl es-ES), workspace-members-pulse visible with workspace-members-count '151' — both match API total_members. (2) /join → email tab → register with fresh 'welcome.qa.<ts>@puntocero.test-e2e.com' → redirected to /; welcome-modal appears within 8s; welcome-modal-counter text: 'Ahora somos 151 miembros creciendo juntos cada día.'; welcome-modal-cta closes modal and URL stays '/'; reload — modal does NOT re-appear. (3) welcome-modal-backdrop click (outside card) closes modal. (4) Login as member.demo@puntocero.test-e2e.com/MemberDemo2026 → at / workspace-members-pulse visible + workspace-members-count '154' = live API; circle workspace-members-counter absent when authed (by design per spec). (5) Responsive: zero horizontal scroll at 360/390/414/768/1024/1280/1440/1920 across /, /join, /empresas/microsoft, /noticias. (6) Welcome modal at 360x780/768x1024/1440x900 — modal bounding box fully within viewport, no clipping, no horizontal scroll. (7) TrendingCompaniesWidget still present on /. All wave8b regression endpoints still 200. Only cosmetic gap: modal displays pre-registration count (N-1) because useCommunityStats' initial fetch races the register POST — modal opens ~350ms after landing but the counter cache is from before the new user was created; a targeted refetch after armWelcome + landing would show N=current. Non-blocking (still shows valid live number and formatting).

integration_issues.issue: Modal shows N=total_members BEFORE the just-registered user is counted (e.g. shows 151 while API is 152). useCommunityStats initial fetch happens on mount and is not refetched right after the register call. Spec allows this (N equals current total from client cache) but ideally armWelcome should also call refetch or WelcomeModal should call refetch on open.

issues: Console 401 on /api/community/auth/me for anon visits (pre-existing, from iter 21) — consider returning 200 {authenticated:false}.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: refetch community stats immediately after successful register (e.g. call refetch inside WelcomeModal useEffect when modal opens, or expose a global bump on armWelcome) so the modal shows the post-register count instead of the cached pre-register count.
critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeModal.jsx uses two setTimeouts (350ms show + 220ms navigate on close) — reasonable, but couples show timing to layout; consider a stable ready-signal from CommunityAuthContext instead.

useCommunityStats has a poll interval of 45s but WelcomeModal instantiates its own with 60s — two concurrent pollers on the same route. Consider hoisting to a context/singleton to dedupe requests and avoid the pre-register count race described above.
community_stats_routes.py counts on every call; fine at current traffic but consider a short in-memory cache (5-10s TTL) if traffic scales.

Frontend fetch in useCommunityStats uses credentials:'omit' — good; no cookies leaked. But the 401 spam from /api/community/auth/me for anon users remains — surface a graceful {authenticated:false} 200 to clean console.

WelcomeModal uses framer-motion AnimatePresence with a hard `if (!open) return null` before AnimatePresence — exit animation is effectively skipped. Move the null check inside AnimatePresence child or use presence-aware key.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of spec assertions (modal count freshness noted as minor)

seed_data_creation: Registered 3 disposable test users during flow tests: welcome.qa.<ts>@puntocero.test-e2e.com — total_members grew 151→154 during the run. Not cleaned up (no delete endpoint used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave UX Bienvenida Dinámica is production-ready. All spec assertions passed on preview URL. Only cosmetic finding: welcome modal's counter shows pre-register total_members because useCommunityStats hasn't refetched after registration completes. Backend endpoint, register flow, one-shot localStorage trigger, backdrop close, CTA close, reload-noop, responsive at 8 breakpoints, and pulse-visible-when-authed are all confirmed. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_wave_ux_community_stats.py can be reused for regression.
